title: Dreamy Cloud Ladder
coreRelationships: The woman is centrally positioned, interacting with a white ladder that extends upwards.
Her dress seamlessly blends into the surrounding pink clouds, creating a sense of unity.
Bright light emanates from the upper right, illuminating the scene and creating highlights on the clouds and the woman.
The ladder provides a strong vertical element contrasting with the soft, amorphous clouds.
reuseFormula: Generate a dreamy, ethereal scene featuring a woman with long blonde hair in a voluminous pink and white ruffled dress, ascending a white ladder amidst soft, glowing pink clouds. A strong light source should emanate from the upper right. Overlay custom script lettering 'Cloud9' in a light, semi-transparent pink/white gradient, integrated into the cloud background, with a decorative initial 'C' and a looping 'd'.
